3455-3518-4812-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.

Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.

3457-4613-6218.description:

Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.

728-2452-3249-4474--56.description:

Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

Repeat.

2034-3480-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Corpsejack Menace
Repeat.

413-1303-3249-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Blasting Station and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Shambling Ghast.
When the Shambling Ghast token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat steps 5 through 7 once using the Shambling Ghast token instead.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

4659-6741-7282.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three multicolored permanents.
4659-6741-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing three Robots, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

74-206-2043-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.

Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-3703-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

232-1235-2556-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Mnemonic Wall.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Mnemonic Wall with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Mnemonic Wall tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

360-2034-3490-6824.description:
Gain life.

Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-5078-5402-6556.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-6556.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.

Brallin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain life.

Repeat from step 2.

907-5451-5702-6664.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.

Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.

Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.

The +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on that creature are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1, scrying 1.
Repeat.

4067-5125-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R} or {G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or creature spells with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Helga triggers, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
When Sparkcaster enters the battlefield, its first and second ability trigger.
Resolve the first Sparkcaster trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Sparkcaster trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Helga.
Repeat.
4067-5125-5922.notes: If you have enough leftover mana to cast the creature, you can instead substitute untapping another permanent instead of Helga.

Kaya's Ghostform attached to Muldrotha.

2730-3719-3967-5131.description:

When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Muldrotha and create six Treasure artifact tokens.
When Muldrotha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Muldrotha.
Repeat.

Coiling Stalker and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Coiling Stalker or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{G}{U}{U}.
307-2291-2792.description:

Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Coiling Stalker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Coiling Stalker's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{G} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Coiling Stalker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

Pemmin's Aura attached to Kibo.
104-2060-2625-3525.description:
Activate Kibo by tapping it, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.

Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kibo.
Repeat.

Resolve the Mana Crypt ability, attaching it to Cephalid Illusionist.

914-2136-2178-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.

914-2136-2178-5256.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Dockside Extortionist token.
When the Dockside Extortionist token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Dockside Extortionist token's power.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may instead use Orthion's second ability to make copies of any creature(s) you control.

Resolve the Oathkeeper trigger, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.

Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding two mana of any colors.
Repeat.

2034-3635-5003.description:

When Whirler Rogue dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Whirler Rogue from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Whirler Rogue enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2283-2399-4050.description:
Sacrifice Brindle Shoat to activate Phyrexian Altar, adding {G}.
Brindle Shoat's death trigger creates a 3/3 Boar token.
Sacrifice the Boar to activate Phyrexian Altar, adding {G}.
Return Brindle Shoat to your hand using Colfenor's trigger.
Repeat.

1636-4518.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{W}.

Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Kor Skyfisher.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm's trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher's trigger, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

366-2034-5003-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing four +1/+1 counters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workhorse, adding {C}{C}.
Workhorse dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Workhorse from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Workhorse enters the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Purphoros triggers, dealing 2 damages to each opponent.
Repeat.
